framework.name: FDA AI/ML Software as Medical Device
framework.version: FDA AI/ML Action Plan 2021 + 2023 Draft Guidance
framework.jurisdiction: United States — Medical Device and Healthcare AI
framework.description: FDA's regulatory framework for AI and machine learning-based Software as a Medical Device. Addresses the unique challenges of AI/ML software that can learn and change through real-world use. Key concepts include Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCPs), Algorithm Change Protocols (ACPs), Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP), and Total Product Lifecycle (TPLC) oversight.

requirements.title: SaMD-1 — Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP)
requirements.text: AI/ML-based SaMD sponsors shall develop and submit a Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) that anticipates planned modifications to the AI/ML algorithm. The PCCP shall specify: the description of planned modifications; the methodology for implementing modifications; and the performance evaluation plan to assess the impact of modifications. A PCCP allows certain modifications without requiring a new marketing submission.
requirements.scope: AI/ML-based SaMD seeking FDA clearance or approval

controls.description: Develop a PCCP describing planned algorithm modifications, implementation methodology, and performance evaluation criteria
Include PCCP in the marketing submission (510(k), De Novo, or PMA) and obtain FDA acceptance
Establish a governance process to manage changes within and outside PCCP boundaries

requirements.title: SaMD-2 — Algorithm Change Protocol (ACP)
requirements.text: Sponsors shall establish an Algorithm Change Protocol specifying the conditions under which the AI/ML algorithm may be modified without requiring additional FDA submissions. The ACP shall define: types of performance data that will be collected; reference standard for evaluation; statistical approach; and update criteria (including retraining triggers).
requirements.scope: AI/ML-based SaMD with continuous learning or periodic retraining capabilities

controls.description: Develop an ACP defining update types, performance evaluation methodology, and update decision criteria
Define locked vs. adaptive algorithm components and their respective change management requirements
Establish retraining triggers and document criteria for when a new marketing submission is required

requirements.title: SaMD-3 — Clinical Validation and Analytical Validation
requirements.text: AI/ML-based SaMD requires both analytical and clinical validation before marketing. Analytical validation demonstrates the algorithm's technical performance (sensitivity, specificity, AUC, etc.). Clinical validation demonstrates that algorithm outputs translate to meaningful clinical outcomes in the intended patient population and clinical environment.
requirements.scope: All AI/ML-based SaMD seeking marketing authorisation

controls.description: Conduct analytical validation measuring technical performance metrics against an appropriate reference standard
Conduct clinical validation demonstrating clinical utility in the intended use population
Validate performance across clinically relevant subgroups including demographic, disease severity, and site diversity

requirements.title: SaMD-4 — Training, Tuning, and Test Dataset Documentation
requirements.text: Sponsors shall document the training, tuning, and test datasets used for AI/ML SaMD development. Documentation shall include: data sources; collection methodology; inclusion/exclusion criteria; patient demographics; data preprocessing steps; and dataset splits. Independent test sets shall not be used during training or tuning.

controls.description: Produce comprehensive dataset documentation covering training, tuning, and test sets
Demonstrate independence of test dataset from training and tuning processes
Document data preprocessing pipeline and version-controlled transformations

requirements.title: SaMD-5 — Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP)
requirements.text: AI/ML SaMD development shall comply with Good Machine Learning Practice principles jointly issued by FDA, Health Canada, and MHRA. GMLP principles include: multidisciplinary teams; training/test data independence; reference standard justification; clinical study design; model performance assessment; transparency and reproducibility; and robust data practices.

controls.description: Document compliance with each of the 10 GMLP principles in the development record
Ensure multidisciplinary team composition covering AI/ML expertise, clinical expertise, and relevant regulatory expertise

requirements.title: SaMD-6 — Transparency and Labelling
requirements.text: AI/ML SaMD labelling shall provide transparency about the algorithm including: intended use and indications for use; performance characteristics; known limitations and failure modes; input data requirements; and clinical workflow integration guidance. Labelling shall enable informed clinical use.

controls.description: Develop labelling that clearly discloses AI/ML algorithm characteristics, performance, and limitations
Disclose training data characteristics relevant to intended clinical use populations

requirements.title: SaMD-7 — Real-World Performance Monitoring Plan
requirements.text: Sponsors shall develop and implement a real-world performance monitoring plan for AI/ML SaMD. The plan shall specify: performance metrics to be monitored; data collection methodology; reference standard for ongoing comparison; monitoring frequency; and performance thresholds that trigger corrective action.

controls.description: Develop and implement a real-world performance monitoring plan submitted as part of PCCP
Collect and analyse real-world performance data at defined intervals
Define and monitor performance thresholds that trigger PCCP review or regulatory reporting

requirements.title: SaMD-8 — Medical Device Reporting (MDR) for AI Failures
requirements.text: Sponsors shall comply with Medical Device Reporting (MDR) requirements for AI/ML SaMD malfunctions or failures that cause or could cause serious injury. Reportable events include: significant unexpected performance degradation; algorithm outputs contributing to clinical adverse events; and cybersecurity incidents affecting AI/ML system integrity.

controls.description: Establish MDR processes covering AI/ML-specific failure modes and reporting criteria
Implement AI/ML failure detection systems to identify reportable events

requirements.title: SaMD-9 — Post-Market Surveillance for AI/ML SaMD
requirements.text: Sponsors shall conduct proactive post-market surveillance for AI/ML SaMD including: collection of real-world clinical outcome data; monitoring for distribution shift in input data; assessment of performance across deployment sites and patient subgroups; and evaluation of clinical workflow integration effects on algorithm performance.

controls.description: Implement proactive post-market surveillance programme covering real-world performance and clinical outcomes
Monitor for data distribution shift at deployment sites
Evaluate clinical workflow integration and its effects on algorithm use and performance

requirements.title: SaMD-10 — PCCP Updates and Regulatory Notifications
requirements.text: Sponsors shall update the PCCP when modifications fall outside the approved PCCP boundaries or when significant changes are made to the performance evaluation plan. Changes requiring a new marketing submission shall be identified and submitted appropriately. FDA shall be notified of significant post-market findings.
requirements.scope: All marketed AI/ML-based SaMD with approved PCCPs

controls.description: Establish a PCCP update process with criteria for when updates require FDA notification
Document and submit all required regulatory notifications for out-of-PCCP modifications

requirements.title: SaMD-11 — Quality Management System for AI/ML SaMD
requirements.text: AI/ML SaMD development and post-market activities shall be conducted within a quality management system compliant with 21 CFR Part 820 (QSR) or ISO 13485. The QMS shall encompass AI/ML-specific processes including: training data management; model configuration management; algorithm change controls; and post-market performance management.

controls.description: Maintain a QMS (21 CFR Part 820 / ISO 13485 compliant) with AI/ML-specific procedures
Include AI/ML training data management, model versioning, and algorithm change control in the QMS

requirements.title: SaMD-12 — Software Lifecycle (IEC 62304 Compliance)
requirements.text: AI/ML SaMD software shall be developed in compliance with IEC 62304 (Medical Device Software Lifecycle). AI/ML software shall be assigned a software safety class (A, B, or C) and appropriate lifecycle activities applied. ML training code, model artefacts, and inference code shall all be managed under the IEC 62304 software configuration management process.

controls.description: Classify AI/ML software under IEC 62304 safety classes and apply proportionate lifecycle controls
Apply configuration management to ML training code, model artefacts, and inference pipeline
evidence_needed: Version control evidence for all AI/ML components

requirements.title: SaMD-13 — Risk Management (ISO 14971)
requirements.text: Risk management for AI/ML SaMD shall comply with ISO 14971. Risk analysis shall address AI/ML-specific failure modes including: incorrect algorithm outputs; distribution shift; adversarial inputs; and human-AI interaction failures. Risk management shall be a living process updated with post-market experience.

controls.description: Conduct ISO 14971 risk analysis for AI/ML SaMD with AI-specific failure modes
Update risk management file with post-market experience and real-world performance data

requirements.title: SaMD-14 — Cybersecurity for AI/ML SaMD
requirements.text: AI/ML SaMD shall address cybersecurity risks including AI-specific threats: adversarial attacks on inference; training data poisoning; model theft; and manipulation of connected data sources. Cybersecurity activities shall comply with FDA's Cybersecurity Guidance for Medical Devices and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
requirements.scope: All AI/ML SaMD with network connectivity or data interfaces

controls.description: Conduct AI-specific cybersecurity risk assessment covering adversarial attacks, data poisoning, and model integrity
Implement and test security controls for AI/ML SaMD inputs, outputs, and model artefacts
Establish a post-market cybersecurity monitoring and vulnerability management programme
